blocks.text: Pharmaceutical industry (dawaiyan banane wali industry) mein bani hui dawaiyan insaan ki sehat ke liye bohat zaroori hain. Chemistry yeh raaz kholti hai ke dawa jism ke andar asal mein kaise kaam karti hai. Kisi dawa ki safety limits (kitni miqdar tak dawa mehfooz hai) aur optimal dose range (sab se behtar dose ki had) medicine ke do bohat ahem pehlu hain. Jab hum jaante hain ke dawa kitni mehfooz hai aur kaise kaam karti hai, to dawa jism mein theek tarah absorb (jazb) hoti hai aur sahi bimari par asar karti hai. Is chapter mein yahi baatein samjhayi jayengi.

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke woh do ahem pehlu kaun se hain jin ki baat is chapter mein hogi?
blocks.explanation: Dawa ki safety limits (kitni miqdar tak mehfooz hai) aur us ki optimal dose range (sab se behtar dose ki had).

items: Chemistry batati hai ke dawa jism ke andar kaise kaam karti hai.
Dawa ke do ahem pehlu: safety limits aur optimal dose range.
